verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Notion is used for task and project tracking with flexible databases, which a PM could adapt to coordinate launches. One user also notes they hit the limits of what can be automated when using it as a project tracker. Nothing in the pack addresses dependency tracking specifically. Missing for 10: documented dependency or blocking relationships between tasks, cross-team dependency views (e.g. timeline or Gantt dependencies), launch-coordination features, and hands-on corroboration of dependency tracking at scale.
